covered: weapon selection, firing and reload input
native movement, projectiles, damage and respawn
remaining_script: deathmatch/server/bot_population.gd:maintain admission, replacement and count maintenance (1 Hz bridge cadence)

bot_server.engine_distinction: NavigationServer3D and AStar3D search algorithms are engine-native; hierarchical routing policy, path marshaling and setup remain GDScript.
bot_server.parity_limit: The native planner is not a line-for-line port of deathmatch/bots.gd. It emits a bounded CQ subset; legacy non-CQ modes/practice retain the GDScript bot controller.
bot_server.verification: Native protocol tests exercise negative bot IDs, navigation following, firing, authoritative projectile damage and snapshot identity; full core suite passes 919593 checks.
decision_gaps_observed: Core::tick_bots has no explicit vehicle boarding/tactics decision code.
No explicit jetpack activation, medic revive/drag, or scout cloak decision code in this CQ planner; do not assume parity with all legacy bot behaviors.

native_gameplay: typed persistent player state and input consumption
weapons, projectile simulation, damage and hit attribution
capture/scoring, squads, respawn and round control

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: Admission/counts, nav setup/bake and route orchestration. Core requests each active bot route approximately every 0.8 s.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Profile first; batch/cache/stagger route requests and reduce cross-language calls.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: Native concealment rule calls GDScript cached tuft generation/contact only for live unmounted prone players at 10 Hz.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Useful pure-data candidate for native rewrite; preserve exact planting/RNG/float32 parity.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: C++ helper handles candidates, structural status and mesh patching. Script still manages LOS gating, broken/collapsed dictionaries, collider/scene updates and destruction RPC state. Collapse damage itself returns to native collapse_region.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Profile impact/collider commit work; moving numerical work alone cannot remove owner-thread Jolt/scene commits.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: ENet polling, FastLZ invocation, MTU slicing, per-peer RPC fanout, control/vote publication and joins remain scripted. Native core already constructs the binary frame; FastLZ and ENet implementations are engine-native.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Profile 20 Hz fanout and copies at target population; candidate for native batching.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: Config/RCON/logging, authentication/admission, avatar/map transfer, asset validation, votes, profile save/restore and native-world setup remain GDScript.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Mostly cold/event-driven; lower priority without measured spikes.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: Map/collision/scene orchestration and resource setup remain scripts, with native world generation/selection helpers. Jolt integration itself is C++/engine-native.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Separate startup/residency timings from steady-state server ticks.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: Seed RPCs and schedule sampling remain scripted; dedicated headless path returns before rain/audio/GPU work. Native authority handles day/night exposure gameplay.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Low headless cost expected; measure before porting.

remaining_script_or_hybrid.area: Legacy reference authority and other gamemodes
remaining_script_or_hybrid.work: Old Dictionary-based reference simulation remains selectable with --cq-script-authority and for non-dedicated/practice paths. Its presence does not imply the default dedicated CQ server executes it.
remaining_script_or_hybrid.priority: Retain as regression reference unless intentionally removing compatibility.

caveat: This is an ownership/call-path audit. No percentage of CPU time or expected speedup is claimed without profiling the target server.
